positions.as_written: Assess the marrow on a T1 weighted sequence, where replacement is most conspicuous.
Assess for oedema on a fat suppressed fluid sensitive sequence.
Assess the cortex as a dark line and accept that a fine cortical detail is a radiographic or computed tomography question.
Assess the subchondral plate separately, since it is where most knee marrow pathology sits.
